```{r}
#| label: build_dataset_FI
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'

# File info
# re

query <- 
glue_sql('SELECT \'FI\' AS "RecordType",
ser_cou_code AS "Country", 
ver_year AS "Year",
spe_scientificname AS "Species",
ser_wkg_code AS "WorkingGroup",
ver_version AS "Version",
1001 AS "DatarightsHolder" 
FROM {`schema`}.t_series_ser
JOIN {`refschema`}.tr_version_ver on ver_code = ser_ver_code
JOIN ref.tr_species_spe on ser_spe_code = spe_code
WHERE ser_code IN ({ss*}) LIMIT 1',
  ss = params$samplingscheme, .con = con_diaspara)

FI <- dbGetQuery(con_diaspara, query)

write.csv(FI,
          file.path(folder, "FI.csv"),
                    quote =FALSE,           na = "",           row.names = FALSE)
```

*FI : `r nrow(FI)`*

```{r}
#| label: build_dataset_sampling_scheme_SS
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'
query <- 
glue_sql('SELECT 
\'SS\' AS "RecordType",
ser_code AS "SamplingSchemeID",
10777 AS "StationCode", 
ser_fiw_code AS "Fishway",
ser_mon_code AS "MonitoringDevice",
spe_scientificname AS "Species",
ser_lfs_code AS "LifeStage",
ser_are_code AS "Area",
gea_icesvalue AS "Gear",
case WHEN ser_stocking THEN \'Y\'
     WHEN NOT ser_stocking THEN \'N\' 
     ELSE NULL
     END AS "RestockingFlag",
\'"https://doi.org/10.17895/ices.pub.30488120"\' AS DOI,
ser_gea_code,
gea_description
FROM {`schema`}.t_series_ser
JOIN ref.tr_gear_gea on gea_code = ser_gea_code
JOIN ref.tr_species_spe on ser_spe_code = spe_code
WHERE ser_code IN ({ss*})',
ss = params$samplingscheme, .con = con_diaspara)


SS <- dbGetQuery(con_diaspara, query)

# TODO REMOVE LATER: Fix because some gears don't yet have a correspondence

missing_gears <- paste(SS$SamplingSchemeID[is.na(SS$Gear)],
                       SS$ser_gea_code[is.na(SS$Gear)],
                       SS$gea_description[is.na(SS$Gear)]) |>  purrr::discard(is.na) 
SS <- SS |> select(-ser_gea_code, -gea_description)
SS[is.na(SS$Gear) & is.na(SS$Fishway), "Gear"] <- "MIS"

write.csv(SS,
          file.path(folder, "SS.csv"),
                    quote =FALSE,        
                    na = "",
                    row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: build_dataset_Annual_series_TS
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'
query <- 
glue_sql('SELECT 
\'TS\' AS "RecordType",
ser_code AS "SamplingSchemeID",
san_year AS "Year",
NULL AS "Age",
san_value AS "Value",
uni_icesvalue AS "Unit",
san_effort AS "Effort",
uni_icesvalue_effort AS "UnitEffort",
san_qal_id AS "QualityCode",
san_comment AS "Comments"
FROM {`schema`}.t_series_ser 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_serannual_san ON san_ser_id = ser_id
JOIN ref.tr_units_uni on uni_code = ser_uni_code
JOIN (SELECT uni_code, uni_icesvalue as uni_icesvalue_effort FROM ref.tr_units_uni ) as uni2 on uni2.uni_code = ser_effort_uni_code
WHERE ser_code IN ({ss*})',
ss = params$samplingscheme, .con = con_diaspara)


TS <- dbGetQuery(con_diaspara, query)
TS$Comments <- gsub(",", ";",TS$Comments)

write.csv(TS,
          file.path(folder, "TS.csv"),
                    quote =FALSE,        
                    na = "",
                    row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: build_dataset_group_metrics_GM
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'



# GM GROUP METRICS 
# note sex is in subsamples not samples

query <- 
  glue_sql('
SELECT 
\'GM\' AS "RecordType",
gr_id AS "GroupID",
ser_code AS "SamplingSchemeID",
gr_year AS "Year",
NULL AS "AgeClass",
gr_lfs_code AS "LifeStage",
gr_number AS "NumberofIndividuals",
gr_comment AS "Comments",            
-- gr_sex_code AS "Sex",
grt_tra_code,
grt_value,
grt_trm_code,
grt_trv_code
FROM {`schema`}.t_series_ser 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_group_gr ON gr_ser_id = ser_id 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_grouptrait_grt ON grt_gr_id = gr_id 
AND gr_gr_id IS NULL
WHERE ser_code IN ({ss*})',
ss = params$samplingscheme, .con = con_diaspara)
GM0 <- dbGetQuery(con_diaspara, query)

if (nrow(GM0)>0){
  # GM grt_tra_code, grt_value, grt_trv_code, grt_trm_code
  
  GMnumeric <-
    GM0 |> 
    filter(is.na(grt_trv_code) & !is.na(grt_value))  |>
    select(-grt_trv_code) 
  
  GMqualitative <-   GM0 |> 
    filter(!is.na(grt_trv_code) & is.na(grt_value))  |>
    select(-grt_value) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("grt_tra_code")), 
      values_from ="grt_trv_code") 
  
  # no qualitative values for Group metrics
  
  GM_without_method <- GMnumeric |> filter(is.na(grt_trm_code)) |>
    select(-grt_trm_code) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("grt_tra_code")), 
      values_from = all_of(c("grt_value")))
  
  map_method <- c(Muscle_lipid = "grt_value_Muscle_lipid",
                  Anguillicola_proportion = "grt_value_Anguillicola_proportion",
                  Anguillicola_intensity = "grt_value_Anguillicola_intensity",
                  Female_proportion="grt_value_Female_proportion",
                  MuscleLipidMethod="grt_trm_code_Muscle_lipid",
                  SexDeterminationMethod="grt_trm_code_Female_proportion",
                  AnguillicolaMethod="grt_trm_code_Anguillicola_intensity")
  
  
  
  GM_with_method <- GMnumeric |> filter(!is.na(grt_trm_code)) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("grt_tra_code")), 
      values_from = all_of(c("grt_value", "grt_trm_code"))) |>
    rename(any_of(map_method))
  if ("grt_trm_code_Anguillicola_proportion" %in% colnames(GM_with_method))
    GM_with_method <- GM_with_method |>  select (-grt_trm_code_Anguillicola_proportion) 
  # last one grt_trm_code_Anguillicola_proportion is twice there, the same for
  # proportion and intensity
  
  # GM_structure used to get all columns for the format
  GM_structure <- data.frame(
    RecordType = character(),
    GroupID = character(),
    SamplingSchemeID = character(),
    Year = integer(),
    LifeStage = character(),
    Age = numeric(),
    LifeStageProportion = numeric(),
    NumberofIndividuals = integer(),
    Length = numeric(),
    Weight = numeric(),
    SexDeterminationMethod = character(),
    SexPrepMethod  = character(),
    SexMethodOfAnalysis = character(),
    FemaleProportion = numeric(),
    DifferentiatedProportion = numeric(),
    AnguillicolaProportion = numeric(),
    AnguillicolaIntensity = numeric(),
    AnguillicolaMethod = character(),
    AnguillicolaPrepMethod = character(),
    MuscleLipidPercent = numeric(),
    MuscleLipidMethod = character(),
    PCB = numeric(),
    TEQ = numeric(),
    EVEXProportion = numeric(),
    HVAProportion = numeric(),
    Pb = numeric(),
    Cd = numeric(),
    Hg = numeric(),
    Comments = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # need to merge proportions
  # No data currently in group metrics for PCB or or TEQ
  # 
  # select only added columns
  col_to_remove <- colnames(GM_with_method) %in% colnames(GM_without_method) & 
    colnames(GM_with_method) !="GroupID" 
  GM_with_method <- GM_with_method[,!col_to_remove]
  
  GM1 <- full_join(
    GM_without_method |> mutate(GroupID = as.character(GroupID)),
    GM_with_method |> mutate(GroupID = as.character(GroupID)), by = join_by(GroupID)) 
  
  if ("LifeStageProportion" %in% colnames(GM_with_method)){
    GM1 <- GM1 |> mutate(LifeStageProportion = 
                           ifelse(is.na(S_in_ys_proportion), G_in_gy_proportion, S_in_ys_proportion)) 
  }
  
  GM1 <- GM1  |>
    rename(any_of(c("Length" = "Lengthmm",
                    "Weight" = "Weightg",
                    "Age" = "Ageyear",
                    "FemaleProportion"="Female_proportion",
                    "AnguillicolaProportion" = "Anguillicola_proportion",
                    "DifferentiatedProportion" = "Differentiated_proportion",
                    "AnguillicolaIntensity"="Anguillicola_intensity",
                    "MuscleLipidPercent"= "Muscle_lipid",
                    "EVEXProportion" = "Evex_proportion",
                    "HVAProportion"="Hva_proportion"
    ))) 
  
  
  GM <-  bind_rows(GM_structure , GM1) |>
    select(RecordType,
           GroupID,
           SamplingSchemeID,
           Year,
           LifeStage,
           Age,  
           LifeStageProportion,
           NumberofIndividuals,
           Length,
           Weight,  
           SexDeterminationMethod,
           SexPrepMethod,
           SexMethodOfAnalysis,
           FemaleProportion, 
           DifferentiatedProportion,  
           AnguillicolaProportion, 
           AnguillicolaIntensity,
           AnguillicolaMethod,  
           AnguillicolaPrepMethod,
           MuscleLipidPercent, 
           MuscleLipidMethod,
           PCB, 
           TEQ, 
           EVEXProportion,
           HVAProportion,
           Pb,
           Cd,
           Hg,
           Comments)
  
  # " PCB" = "Sum_6_pcb",
  
  
  GM <- GM |> 
    filter(SamplingSchemeID %in% params$samplingscheme) 
  GM$Comments <- gsub(",", ";",GM$Comments)
  GM$Comments <- paste0('"',GM$Comments,'"')
  
  GM <- GM |> 
    mutate(Comments =  gsub(",", ";",Comments),
           Comments = if_else(
             condition = nchar(Comments) > 187,
             true = paste0(substr(Comments, 1, 187),"... truncated"),
             false = Comments,
             missing = NA
           ),
           SexDeterminationMethod = if_else(is.na(SexDeterminationMethod) & !is.na(FemaleProportion), 	"Length_based_sex",NA))
  write.csv(GM,
            file.path(folder, "GM.csv"),
            quote =FALSE,        
            na = "",
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: build_dataset_group_subsample_GS
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'

# GS note sex is in subsamples not samples
query <- 
glue_sql('
SELECT 
\'GS\' AS "RecordType",
ser_code AS "SamplingSchemeID", 
gr_id::TEXT AS "SubSampleID",
gr_gr_id::TEXT AS "GroupID",
gr_year AS "Year",
gr_lfs_code AS "LifeStage",
NULL AS "AgeClass",
gr_sex_code AS "Sex",
gr_number AS "NumberofIndividuals",
gr_comment AS "Comments",            
grt_tra_code,
grt_value,
grt_trm_code,
grt_trv_code
FROM {`schema`}.t_series_ser 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_group_gr ON gr_ser_id = ser_id 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_grouptrait_grt ON grt_gr_id = gr_id 
WHERE ser_code IN ({ss*})
AND gr_gr_id IS NOT NULL',
ss = params$samplingscheme,
.con = con_diaspara)
GS0 <- dbGetQuery(con_diaspara, query)

if (nrow(GS0)>0){
  # GM grt_tra_code, grt_value, grt_trv_code, grt_trm_code
  
  GSnumeric <-
    GS0 |> 
    filter(is.na(grt_trv_code) & !is.na(grt_value))  |>
    select(-grt_trv_code) 
  
  GSqualitative <-   GS0 |> 
    filter(!is.na(grt_trv_code) & is.na(grt_value))  |>
    select(-grt_value) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("grt_tra_code")), 
      values_from ="grt_trv_code") 
  
  # no qualitative values for Group metrics
  # below found duplicates in subSampleID in the DB.
  # Two different subSampleID, one with weight, the other with length.
  # so it's no longer in the id_cols
  GS_without_method <- GSnumeric |> filter(is.na(grt_trm_code)) |>
    select(-grt_trm_code) |>
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = any_of(c("RecordType", 
                         "SamplingSchemeID",
                         "GroupID", 
                         "Year", 
                         "LifeStage",
                         "AgeClass", 
                         "Sex",
                         "NumberofIndividuals",
                         "Comments")),
      names_from = all_of(c("grt_tra_code")), 
      values_from = all_of(c("grt_value")))
  
  GS_without_method <- GS_without_method |> 
    inner_join(GSnumeric |> select(any_of(c("RecordType", 
                                            "SamplingSchemeID",
                                            "SubSampleID",
                                            "GroupID", 
                                            "Year", 
                                            "LifeStage",
                                            "AgeClass", 
                                            "Sex"))) |> 
                 distinct(RecordType, 
                          SamplingSchemeID,
                          GroupID, 
                          Year, 
                          LifeStage,
                          AgeClass, 
                          Sex,.keep_all = TRUE),
               by=join_by(RecordType, 
                          SamplingSchemeID,
                          GroupID, 
                          Year, 
                          LifeStage,
                          AgeClass, 
                          Sex))
  
  # method is always about sex there   
  GS_with_method <- GSnumeric |> filter(!is.na(grt_trm_code)) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("grt_tra_code")), 
      values_from = all_of(c("grt_value"))) |>
    rename("SexDeterminationMethod" = "grt_trm_code") 
  
  # last one grt_trm_code_Anguillicola_proportion is twice there, the same for
  # proportion and intensity
  
  
  
  GS_structure <- data.frame(
    RecordType = character(),            # char(2)
    SubSampleID = character(),           # char(10)
    GroupID = character(),               # char(20)
    LifeStage = character(),             # char(10), code list STAGE
    AgeClass = character(),
    Sex = character(),                   # char(2), code list SEXCO
    Age = integer(),                     # int(2)
    NumberofIndividuals = numeric(),
    Length = numeric(),                  # float(10)
    Weight = numeric(),                  # float(10)
    SexDeterminationMethod = character(), # char(20), code list METOA
    SexPrepMethod = character(),
    SexMethodOfAnalysis = character(), # char(200)
    FemaleProportion =  numeric(),
    DifferentiatedProportion = numeric(),
    AnguillicolaProportion = numeric(),  # float(5)
    AnguillicolaIntensity = numeric(),   # float(5)
    AnguillicolaMethod = character(),    # char(20), code list METOA
    AnguillicolaPrepMethod = character(), 
    MuscleLipidPercent = numeric(),      # float(10)
    MuscleLipidMethod = character(),     # char(20), code list METOA
    PCB = numeric(),
    TEQ  = numeric(),
    EVEXProportion = numeric(),
    HVAProportion = numeric(),
    Pb = numeric(),
    Cd = numeric(),
    Hg = numeric(),
    Comments = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  col_to_remove <- colnames(GS_with_method) %in% colnames(GS_without_method) & 
    colnames(GS_with_method) !="GroupID" 
  GS_with_method <- GS_with_method[,!col_to_remove]
  
  GS <- full_join(
    GS_without_method |> mutate(GroupID = as.character(GroupID)),
    GS_with_method |> mutate(GroupID = as.character(GroupID)), by = join_by(GroupID)) |>
    rename(any_of(c(Length = "Lengthmm",
           Weight = "Weightg",
           Age = "Ageyear")))  |>
    select(any_of(c("RecordType",
           "GroupID",
           "SubSampleID",
           "SamplingSchemeID",
           "Year",
           "Sex",
           "AgeClass",
           "LifeStage", 
           "NumberofIndividuals",
           "Age",  
           "Weight",
           "Length",
           "SexDeterminationMethod")))
  
  GS <- bind_rows(GS_structure , 
                  GS |> mutate(GroupID = as.character(GroupID)))
  
  GS <- GS |> 
    filter(SamplingSchemeID %in% params$samplingscheme) |>
    select(- SamplingSchemeID, -Year)
  GS <- GS |> 
    mutate(Comments =  gsub(",", ";",Comments),
           Comments = if_else(
             condition = nchar(Comments) > 187,
             true = paste0(substr(Comments, 1, 187),"... truncated"),
             false = Comments,
             missing = NA
           ),
           SexDeterminationMethod = if_else(is.na(SexDeterminationMethod) & !is.na(FemaleProportion), 	"Length_based_sex",NA))
  write.csv(GS,
            file.path(folder, "GS.csv"),
            quote =FALSE,        
            na = "",
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: build_dataset_Individual_metrics_IM
#| echo: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'


query <- 
glue_sql('
SELECT 
\'IM\' AS "RecordType",
fi_id,
CASE WHEN fi_date IS NULL THEN fi_year 
     ELSE fi_year END AS "Year",
ser_code AS "SamplingSchemeID",
fi_idsource AS "FishID",
fi_lfs_code AS "LifeStage",
CASE WHEN fi_date IS NULL THEN NULL 
ELSE extract(\'MONTH\' FROM fi_date)
END AS "Month",
CASE WHEN fi_date IS NULL THEN NULL 
ELSE extract(\'DAY\' FROM fi_date)
END AS "Day",
fi_x_4326 AS "DecimalLongitude",
fi_y_4326 AS "DecimalLatitude",
int_tra_code,
int_value,
int_trv_code,
int_trm_code,
fi_comment AS "Comments"
FROM {`schema`}.t_series_ser 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_fish_fi ON fi_ser_id = ser_id 
JOIN {`schema`}.t_indivtrait_int ON int_fi_id=fi_id
WHERE ser_code IN ({ss*})',
ss = params$samplingscheme,
.con = con_diaspara)
IM0 <- dbGetQuery(con_diaspara, query) # 1796871

# GM grt_tra_code, grt_value, grt_trv_code, grt_trm_code
if (nrow(IM0)>0){
  IMnumeric <-
    IM0 |> 
    filter(is.na(int_trv_code) & !is.na(int_value))  |>
    select(-int_trv_code) 
  
  IMqualitative <-   IM0 |> 
    filter(!is.na(int_trv_code) & is.na(int_value))  |>
    select(-int_value) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("int_tra_code")), 
      values_from ="int_trv_code") 
  
  # no qualitative values for Group metrics
  
  IM_without_method <- IMnumeric |> filter(is.na(int_trm_code)) |>
    select(-int_trm_code) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("int_tra_code")), 
      values_from = all_of(c("int_value")))
  
  # method is always about sex there   
  IM_with_method <- IMnumeric |> filter(!is.na(int_trm_code)) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(c("int_tra_code")), 
      values_from = all_of(c("int_value", "int_trm_code"))) |>
    rename(any_of(c("MuscleLipidPercent"= "int_value_Muscle_lipid",
           "Anguillicola_intensity" = "int_value_Anguillicola_intensity",
           "MuscleLipidMethod"="int_trm_code_Muscle_lipid",
           "AnguillicolaMethod"="int_trm_code_Anguillicola_intensity"))) 
  
  # last one int_trm_code_Anguillicola_proportion is twice there, the same for
  # proportion and intensity
  
  
  IMstructure <- data.frame(
    RecordType = character(),
    Year = integer(),
    SamplingSchemeID = character(),
    FishID = character(),
    LifeStage = character(),
    Month = integer(),
    Day = integer(),
    DecimalLongitude = numeric(),
    DecimalLatitude = numeric(),
    Sex = character(),
    Age = integer(),
    PigmentationStage = character(),
    SexDeterminationMethod = character(),
    SexPrepMethod = character(),
    SexMethodOfAnalysis = character(),
    Differentiated = character(),
    SeaAge = integer(),
    JuvenileAge = integer(),
    AgingMethod = character(),
    AgingMatrix = character(),
    AgingPrepMethod = character(),
    Length = numeric(),
    LengthMethod = character(),
    Weight = numeric(),
    MeanEyeDiam = numeric(),
    PectoralFinLength = numeric(),
    AnguillicolaMethod = character(),
    AnguillicolaPrepMethod = character(),
    AnguillicolaPresence = character(),
    AnguillicolaIntensity = numeric(),
    MuscleLipidPercent = numeric(),
    MuscleLipidMethod = character(),
    PCB = numeric(),
    TEQ = numeric(),
    EVEXpresence = character(),
    HVAPresence = character(),
    Pb = numeric(),
    Cd = numeric(),
    Hg = numeric(),
    Comments = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # clipr::write_clip(colnames(IM))
  
  col_to_remove <- colnames(IM_with_method) %in% colnames(IM_without_method) & 
    colnames(IM_with_method) !="FishID" 
  IM_with_method <- IM_with_method[,!col_to_remove]
  
  IM <- full_join(
    IM_without_method |> mutate(FishID = as.character(FishID)),
    IM_with_method |> mutate(FishID = as.character(FishID)), by = join_by(FishID)) |>  
    rename(
      any_of(c(
      PectoralFinLength = "Pectoral_lengthmm",
      MeanEyeDiam = "Eye_diam_meanmm",
      Weight = "Weightg",
      Length = "Lengthmm",
      AnguillicolaIntensity = "Anguillicola_intensity",
      Age = "Ageyear",
      PCB = "Sum_6_pcb"))) |> 
    select(-fi_id) 
  
  
  
  IM <- bind_rows(IMstructure , IM)
  
  IM <- IM |> 
    filter(SamplingSchemeID %in% params$samplingscheme) |>
    slice_head(n = 200) |>
    mutate(AgingMatrix = if_else(is.na(Age), "-9" ,"otolith"))
  IM <- IM |> 
    mutate(Comments =  gsub(",", ";",Comments),
           Comments = if_else(
             condition = nchar(Comments) > 187,
             true = paste0(substr(Comments, 1, 187),"... truncated"),
             false = Comments,
             missing = NA
           ))
  write.csv(IM,
            file.path(folder, "IM.csv"),
            quote =FALSE,
            na = "",
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
               paste(params$samplingscheme,collapse="_"),
               paste(names(order),collapse="_"),
```
